factual_and_methodological.summary: Trafigura primary evidence confirms 318.2m metric tonnes of oil and petroleum products traded in FY2025, about 6.6m barrels per day, and employee ownership with more than 1,400 shareholders. The dossier treats these as evidence of physical intermediation, financing and logistics capacity—not resource ownership or unilateral price control.

editorial_publication_readiness.opening: Direct mechanism-led opening; no generic sophistication claims or product-process narration.
editorial_publication_readiness.headings: Headings advance the actor-specific mechanism, constraints, contrary evidence and revision conditions.
editorial_publication_readiness.language_localization: EN and PT-BR are semantically aligned; PT-BR technical prose was localized before approval.
editorial_publication_readiness.cohesion: Argument moves from rights/capability through transmission, constraints and evidence that would revise the assessment.
editorial_publication_readiness.template_meta_qa: No prompt, QA-process, schema, renderer or roadmap leakage detected.

contextual_depth.summary: The dossier distinguishes legal rights, operating capability, transmission, substitutability and institutional constraints rather than relying on scale or reputation.

visual_evidence_readiness.signature: At least two analytical tables, one quantitative chart, one causal flow and one mind map in both locales.
visual_evidence_readiness.limitations: Visuals encode sourced quantities or mechanisms defended in prose and are not combined into a synthetic power score.

contrary_evidence: Competing traders, producer marketing arms and integrated energy companies can substitute many intermediation functions.
Funding stress, compliance constraints, shipping shortages or counterparty losses can rapidly reduce a trader's operational flexibility.
limitations: Substitutability is disruption- and route-specific and cannot be inferred from gross traded volume alone.
Trading volume does not reveal the share of underlying commodity reserves, production or end-demand controlled by the company.
notes: Dedicated single-actor Strategic Actors dossier. Primary-source factual core, controlled taxonomy, bilingual parity and visual evidence reviewed; no public bundle for this ID at approval time.

en.title: Trafigura: structural capacity through physical commodity intermediation
en.deck: Trafigura's structural role comes from coordinating finance, shipping, storage, blending and counterparties across large physical commodity flows. That is intermediation capacity, not ownership of global reserves or unilateral price control.
en.regime: Large physical traders remain important coordinators of fragmented commodity flows, particularly when financing and logistics become binding constraints.
en.key_risk: Trading volume can be misread as ownership or price-setting power, while gross flows depend on funding, logistics and replaceable counterparties.
watch: evidence of substitution by rival intermediaries
en.search_text: Trafigura strategic actor physical commodity trading oil flows trade finance shipping logistics storage structural power

pt-BR.title: Trafigura: capacidade estrutural por intermediação física de commodities
pt-BR.deck: O papel estrutural da Trafigura vem de coordenar financiamento, transporte, armazenagem, mistura e contrapartes em grandes fluxos físicos. Isso é capacidade de intermediação, não propriedade de reservas globais nem poder unilateral de precificação.
pt-BR.regime: Grandes traders físicos continuam relevantes na coordenação de fluxos fragmentados, sobretudo quando financiamento e logística se tornam restrições centrais.
pt-BR.key_risk: Volume negociado pode ser confundido com propriedade ou poder de preço, embora os fluxos dependam de funding, logística e contrapartes substituíveis.
watch: acesso a capital de giro e liquidez

key_constraints: competition from other physical traders and producer marketing arms
publication.selection_rationale: Trafigura is an active Strategic Actors record with documented physical-trade and logistics channels but lacked a dedicated single-actor canonical study.
